top_signals.title: Stocks and Treasuries Rally as Oil Slide Deepens: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks rallied alongside Treasuries as falling oil prices lent support to optimism that inflation can be kept under control a day after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023.
